name: @gino/host-serve
description: Gino host serve adapter — the /agent data plane over host.wire with no HTTP framework: a runtime-neutral request handler plus ready-made Bun.serve and node:http + ws servers.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external && bun build src/bun.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --packages external && bun build src/node.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:node
